question: Which law allowed Indian members to discuss the budget in the Legislative Council for the first time?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indian Council Act, 1892**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Indian Council Act, 1892** marked a significant development in colonial India by introducing reforms to the legislative structure.
 
• For the first time, it allowed **Indian representatives** in the **Legislative Council** to discuss the budget and raise questions about public administration. This was a major step in the political empowerment of Indians during British rule.
 
• It expanded the number of members in the **Legislative Councils** at both the central and provincial levels, providing greater representation to Indians.
 
• The Act introduced the principle of indirect election for selecting Indian representatives to the Council. Though indirect, it allowed Indians to have a say in their governance. *Hence, the correct answer is Indian Council Act, 1892.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Indian Council Act, 1861:**

 
 
• This Act established the **Legislative Councils** in India for the first time, but it did not allow Indian members to discuss the budget or public matters.
 
• The Act marked the beginning of the legislative process in India under British rule by creating **legislative bodies**, but Indians had very limited roles.
 
 
 
• **Government of India Act, 1858:**
 
 
• This Act transferred the administration of India from the **East India Company** to the British Crown following the Revolt of 1857.
 
• It created the office of the **Secretary of State for India** to oversee Indian affairs but did not address legislative representation or discussions in councils.
 
 
 
• **Indian Council Act, 1909:**
 
 
• Also known as the **Morley-Minto Reforms**, this Act introduced **communal representation** by reserving separate electorates for Muslims.
 
• It significantly expanded Indian representation but came much later than the 1892 Act and was focused more on communal issues rather than budget discussions.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Key Features of Indian Council Act, 1892:**

 
 
• It laid the foundation for legislative reforms by introducing **discussion of financial matters** for Indian members in councils.
 
• Although Indians were not directly elected, the Act introduced the concept of indirect elections, paving the way for future democratic reforms.
 
 
 
• **Impact of the Act:**
 
 
• The Act marked a shift in British policy towards recognizing the importance of Indian political participation.
 
• It sowed the seeds for subsequent reforms, including the **Indian Council Act, 1909** and the eventual Government of India Act, 1935.
